verdict.rationale: Elastic documents self-managed deployment, including on-prem and private/public cloud. Community users report running it themselves via the ECK Kubernetes operator or StatefulSets, and say the Elastic License permits self-hosting. Parity with the hosted product is caveated: the full feature set comes only under a trial or paid license (e.g., security and ML add-ons), and capabilities such as autoscaling and cross-project search are documented only for Serverless projects. Missing for 10: evidence of feature parity between self-managed and hosted, full features without a paid license, and production-scale self-managed deployment docs beyond the local quickstart.
